# Betonex

> > Betonex specializes in composite facade cladding solutions and precast concrete building materials, offering innovative systems like CBOARD, PANEL, UHPC, and MARE for architectural applications.

Betonex is a Turkish manufacturer of composite building materials and facade cladding products. The company serves the construction and architecture industries with advanced precast concrete panel systems and decorative cladding solutions.

## Key Topics

- CBOARD technology
- Composite building materials
- Facade cladding products
- Precast concrete panels
- UHPC (Ultra-High Performance Concrete)
- PANEL systems
- MARE cladding
- Architectural cladding
- Sustainable manufacturing
- GRC (Glass Reinforced Concrete)
- Construction materials
- Decorative facade solutions
- Turkey-based manufacturer
- Netherlands operations
